decisions.reason: It supports the firm's stated push into compliance and agency-focused tooling, had its own page in both years, and the website showed positive agency-oriented feedback.
As a core platform product shown on the home page in both 2023 and 2024, it is central to the firm's hosting and automation proposition and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
A configurable managed hosting plan fits the firm's main business directly, remained prominently marketed on its own page, and matches customer demand for scalable managed hosting.
Although less prominently marketed so far, extended PHP security support fits the firm's security and support strengths, so it is more likely to be retained than removed.
